name: DOT1 like histone lysine methyltransferase
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: DOT1L encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase, H3 lysine-79 specific. Annotated molecular activities include histone methyltransferase activity and transcription coactivator activity. It participates in DNA repair and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
